pages.text: Rather than building an air-cooled room, IV players can build a 5×6×5 $(item)API Satellite Station$() to call the simulated closed-source cloud. Like the datacenter, it has $(bold)zero HPCA and zero Research Station prerequisites$().$(br2)Power requirements are tiny: an $(#0E7490)LV or MV Energy Hatch$() is enough (Medium: 30 EU/t, Extra High: 120 EU/t, Fallback: 60 EU/t).

pages.title: Dish Structure & Signal Rules
pages.text: $(li)$(#0E7490)Structure$(): 3×3 $(item)Satellite Dish Frame$() base (controller front-center; hatches and optional fallback gateway go here), truss holding a 5×5 concave $(item)Satellite Dish Panel$() bowl, and a 2-tall $(item)Satellite Feed Horn$() at top center `(2, 5, 2)`.$(li)$(#0E7490)Open Sky$(): no solid-render block may sit above the feed horn (glass is fine), or uplink is refused.$(li)$(#0E7490)Weather & Altitude$(): rain ×1.5 duration, thunder ×2.0; controller at $(bold)Y > 120$() gives ×0.95 bill and ×0.9 duration.

pages.title: Account and Automated Sales
pages.text: Bind an $(item)API Credential Card$() by right-clicking the controller, then put it in the API key slot. The save-wide ledger grants a one-time $(bold)5,000,000 Token$() welcome balance. Use a $(item)Token Credit Card$() to deposit or withdraw the balance.

pages.title: Item Buses
pages.text: Fit a standard $(item)Item Import Bus$() in the 3×3 base. With a bound credential installed, mining and chemical $(item)High-Purity Datasets$() sell for $(bold)50,000 Tokens each$(). Feed the bus with pipes, hoppers or an AE2 export bus. Clean Datasets fed to the same import bus start demo rounds. A standard $(item)Item Export Bus$() collects the demo output.
